# Bayfield Heating & Cooling

> Bayfield Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Bayfield, Huron County, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (519) 565-0204  |  Email: contact@bayfieldheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://bayfieldheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Bayfield, Goderich, Clinton, Vanastra, Hensall
